subject: Re: Encord Label Logs Discussion
text:
Hi Seif,

Thank you for reaching out.

I'll assume you're referring to the use of the SDK activity log:
https://docs.encord.com/sdk-documentation/projects-sdk/sdk-activity-logs

1. We've only used the label activity-logs to confirm if all labelling 'actions', 'values' and 'timestamps' are logged (stored), as we
require providing a full audit-trail of our studies, if requested, for regulatory approval processes.

As we discussed with Oscar, what is exposed in the API is what is currently stored in your database.
Hence, we found out that once classifications' values were deleted from tasks, they could be recovered (if I remember correctly).
Our solution at the moment is to do manual backups in case we need to delete 'classifications' during a study
(such that previous data are not lost).

In case this has changed, and those are now also being stored (i.e. alongside the delete-action), that would be great, as it would make the Encord system fully compliant
with the FDA 21-part 11 audit trail regulation (for data collected during clinical studies) - and avoid us having to make manual backups.

2. Our second use case would be getting the logs timestamps (by collaborator) to confirm the average duration of a CT-scan annotation.
However, we've found your analytics to be as precise as we need, with respect to these annotations' timings.

Therefore, we've not used these logs beyond the first use-case. Do you still want to review this with us?
No need and no worries from our end, in case you're looking for feedback on a different set of use-cases.

Many Thanks,
Best Wishes,
Mauro

Dr. Mauro Santos

Research Scientist

Optellum Ltd. www.optellum.com<http://www.optellum.com/>
